_comment: Step cards per pattern. Set 'photo' to an image path (e.g. photos/NT-7138-1.jpg) to replace the placeholder. 'photoLabel' shows when photo is empty.

NT-7138.text: Pull pattern NT-7138 from B2-S1-R4-2. Check gates and risers are all there.
Ram drag. Strike off, vent, roll over.
Ram cope with 2 exothermic riser sleeves on the bosses.
Blow out mold. Coat and torch dry both halves.
Set core A (nobake) x1. Main bore core.
NT-7138.caution: Check chaplet sizes against the layout photo before closing.

NT-7138.text: Set core B (shell) x2. Port cores, set chaplets first.
Set core C (oil) x4. Bolt hole cores.
Set cope on drag. Clamp and weight the mold.
Pour at 2600 F. Mark the mold with job 9900101.
NT-7138.caution: Ductile: inoculate in the ladle. Pour within 10 min of treatment.

MC-730.text: Pull pattern MC-730 and the HD plate from B4-S2-R3-3.
Ram drag. Vent over the thick flange.
Ram cope. Cut pouring basin on the operator side.
Set cores A to D in order. Blow out and close.

MC-730.caution: Pressure test first parts before shipping.

MC-730.text: Set core D (shell) x3. Use 1/2 in band lug core box.
Set cope on drag. Clamp and weight the mold.
Pour at 2550 F. Mark the mold with job 9900102.
MC-730.caution: See process sheet photos before setting cores.

PP-4410.text: Pull pattern PP-4410 and the vane core prints.
Ram drag with chills on the vane tips. Count chills: 6.
Ram cope. Two open risers on the hub.
Coat both halves heavy. Torch dry.
Set core A (nobake) x1. Vane core, handle with 2 people.
PP-4410.caution: Very hard and brittle. No hammer on castings.

PP-4410.text: Set core B (nobake) x1. Eye core.
Set cope on drag. Clamp and weight the mold.
Pour at 2650 F. Mark the mold with job 9900103.
PP-4410.caution: Ni-Hard: do NOT shake out early. Leave in mold 8 hours minimum.

RC-2207.text: Ram drag and cope. No cores on this job.
Vent over each boss. Blow out and close.
No cores on this job. Check that no core print is showing.
Set cope on drag. Clamp and weight the mold.
Pour at 2500 F. Mark the mold with job 9900104.
RC-2207.caution: No cores. If a core print is showing, stop and call the lead.

HH-510.text: Pull pattern HH-510. Confirm filter print is clean.
Ram drag. Set ceramic filter in the runner.
Ram cope. Vent the center boss.
Set core A. Blow out and close.
Set core A (shell) x8. Port core, check for cracks.
HH-510.caution: Ductile: pour within 10 min of treatment.

HH-510.text: Set cope on drag. Clamp and weight the mold.
Pour at 2600 F. Mark the mold with job 9900105.
HH-510.caution: Cores due from core room at 1:30 PM. Do not close molds without them.
